GTA 6 Cast List: Who plays Jason, Lucia and More
articles.chapeau: Who plays who in Rockstar's crime saga
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has the longest story ever seen in a GTA game, which also means that it has an enormous cast of characters. Between rival faction leaders, radio station DJs, and fictional rappers, you're going to meet a whole lot of people in Leonida. And some of their voices might sound very familiar.
While the full cast list is so large that it takes up a good chunk of GTA 6 's hour-plus end credits, these are some of the biggest players in the story, including Jason and Lucia. Some you might recognize from movies or even previous Rockstar games, while others have some modest TV credits to their name.
Below, we've listed all the actors who play main roles in GTA 6 , along with their previous work that they've starred in.
Jason Duval enjoys a drink in the video game, Grand Theft Auto 6 Image: Rockstar Games Much of GTA 6 's cast comes from a TV background, and that includes Jason Duval. His voice actor, Dylan Rourke, has appeared on shows like 9-1-1: Lone Star , Station 19 , and Grey's Anatomy . GTA 6 is his most high-profile role by a mile, though, unless you count his gig as ”Big Guy” on Modern Family as a star turn.
Grand Theft Auto 6 protagonist Lucia lounges at the pool. Image: Grand Theft Auto 6 Manni L. Perez, the actress behind Lucia Caminos, comes from a similar acting background as Dylan Rourke. Perez has popped up in Law & Order: Special Victims Unit , Chicago P.D. , and The Blacklist . She's also a Rockstar alumni; Perez voices a Clubber in Grand Theft Auto 5 , and a Blackjack Dealer in GTA Online .
Image: Rockstar Games Jason and Lucia's comedic sidekick is one of the biggest stars in the entire cast. He's voiced by Bobby Moynihan, who was a principal cast member of Saturday Night Live from 2008 to 2017. You may remember him as playing Drunk Uncle, a recurring character on Weekend Update that already felt like a GTA bit. Moynihan has a long credits list outside of that, most recently appearing in NCIS: Origins , The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins , and Minions & Monsters .
Image: Rockstar Games The worst kept secret in all of gaming, Stephen Root plays Brian Heder, Jason's employer. He needs little introduction. Root is the man behind Milton in Office Space , Monroe Fuches in Barry , and Bill in King of the Hill , to name a few of his roles. Funny enough, Root is also credited as Florida Man on the TV series It's Florida, Man . Fitting, no?
Image: Rockstar Games A standout in the cast, Dre'Quan plays a major supporting role in GTA 6 once the story gets to Vice City. He's played by Naiqui Macabroad, an actor who has appeared on Law & Order , Chicago P.D. , and Crashing . Macabroad spends a lot of time in the story acting alongside of Hood Brat and Krissy Celess, two Florida-based rappers who appear in the game.
If you want to see the full credits, including the developers and music, you don't have to beat GTA 6 to get them. Head into the Settings menu from the pause screen and tab over to Account. Scroll down to Credits, and you'll be able to scan a QR code that takes you to the credits on a browser. If you want to skip all of that, here's a direct link to the credits .

articles.t: GTA 6 Is Now Out in the US and Canada – PS5 Download Size and Game Sharing Explained
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is out now in the US and Canada. See when it unlocked, how much space you’ll need on PS5, and how PS5 game sharing works.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally out in the US and Canada on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here’s what you need to know before jumping into Leonida, including when the game unlocked, how long it takes to download, and how PS5 game sharing works.
GTA 6 unlocked in California at 9 PM PT on Wednesday, November 18 and is playable right now. If you bought and preloaded the digital version on PS5 or Xbox Series X|S, you can jump in as soon as the game unlocks and any pending updates finish installing.
The West Coast release fell on Wednesday night because the US digital unlock was set for midnight Eastern on Thursday, November 19.
GTA 6 unlocked at 11 PM CT on Wednesday, November 18 for US players in the Central time zone . So if you live in Chicago, Dallas, or anywhere else on Central Time, you can start playing right now an hour before midnight.
Here’s how the US digital release broke down across the four time zones in the contiguous US:
The GTA 6 PS5 download size is around 210 GB . if you’re downloading Grand Theft Auto VI . According to Rockstar’s website the preload can require up to 212 GB of storage space depending on your device. If you’re close to that limit, you can see how much room you have by going to Settings > Storage on your PS5.
The latest reported GTA 6 launch patch on PS5 is version 01.002.001, which is around 602.5 MB . It started rolling out on November 16, so your PS5 may have already installed it if you preloaded the game and have automatic updates enabled.
If you want to check manually, highlight GTA 6 on your PS5 home screen, press the Options button, and select Check for Update .
A 212 GB GTA 6 download takes about 4 hours and 43 minutes at 100 Mbps , assuming your console can sustain that speed the whole time. At 300 Mbps, the same download takes around 1 hour and 34 minutes.
Here’s how long you can expect the full download to take at a few common speeds:
These are download estimates. Your PS5 may take longer if speeds fluctuate or it still needs to install an update. If you already preloaded the full game, check whether you have a patch waiting before starting a new download.
Yes, you can game share GTA 6 on PS5. PlayStation 5 supports sharing eligible digital purchases through Console Sharing and Offline Play. To try it with GTA 6 , sign in with the account that bought the game on the PS5 you want to share it on.
Go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Console Sharing and Offline Play , then select Enable . Download the game through the account that owns it, then switch back to the profile you want to play on. Sony allows each account to enable sharing on one PS5 at a time.
GTA 6 has a 99 out of 100 on Metacritic, making it the highest rated game of all time. In our GTA 6 review , I called Grand Theft Auto VI the best game Rockstar has made to date. Leonida is the most impressive open world I’ve played in, but Jason and Lucia’s relationship is what makes the story stick with you.
After 13 years, it was worth the wait. However, that is just my subjective opinion. I recommend checking out Metacritic’s full list of reviews, and deciding if the game sounds like something you would enjoy or not.

"On a des collaborateurs qui vont poser jusqu'à 10 jours": cette DRH n'avait jamais vu ça, la sortie de GTA 6 provoque une explosion des demandes de vacances dans les entreprises
articles.chapeau: Pour ne rien manquer de la sortie de GTA 6 ce jeudi 19 novembre, des milliers de salariés ont posé des jours de congé, parfois jusqu'à dix jours. En France, les congés prévus pour le jour J bondissent de 35% sur un an, et de 91% en Italie. Un phénomène mondial inédit à cette échelle pour un jeu...
articles.txt:
C'est l'événement de la décennie (et peut-être davantage) dans le jeu vidéo. Certains l'attendent depuis 13 ans. Ce jeudi 19 novembre, c'est le jour J pour le nouveau GTA et pas question de rester coincé au travail en attendant de se précipiter à la maison pour prendre la manette en main et se promener dans Vice City . Pour être certains de pouvoir en profiter dès les premières heures, de nombreux fans ont décidé de prendre des vacances. La sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), prévue dans la nuit du mercredi 18 au jeudi 19 novembre, provoque une vague de demandes de congés dans les entreprises, en France comme à l'étranger.
Certaines entreprises ont même décidé d'encourager leurs salariés à jouer. C'est le cas du fabricant suisse Logitech, qui offre à ses quelque 7.000 collaborateurs dans le monde une journée de congé payé supplémentaire pour jouer aux jeux vidéo, à prendre d'ici novembre 2027. GTA 6 n'est pas obligatoire, chacun peut choisir son jeu.
Il faut dire que Logitech commercialise des accessoires informatiques, notamment dans le jeu vidéo.
Marie, salariée de l'entreprise française Lucca, spécialisée dans les logiciels de gestion des ressources humaines, fait partie de ces passionnés qui ont organisé leurs vacances autour du jeu vidéo de Rockstar Games. "On est tout un groupe d'amis à jouer régulièrement ensemble", raconte-t-elle à BFM Business. "Ayant fait des braquages ensemble sur GTA 5, on attendait le 6 et c'est parti d'une blague sur le fait de prendre des congés et puis finalement, on a tous pris des congés pour profiter du jeu et surtout ne pas être spoilé à droite et à gauche sur les réseaux."
Pour cette joueuse qui a découvert la franchise avec le quatrième opus sorti en 2002 lorsqu'elle avait 11 ou 12 ans, c'est une première. "Pour ma part, je n'ai jamais pris de vacances pour un jeu", explique-t-elle. Elle a toutefois attendu octobre pour déposer sa demande, par crainte d'un nouveau report de la sortie. Ses collègues, prévenus à l'avance, ont accueilli la nouvelle avec humour. "Ils ont rigolé mais comprennent les passions de tout le monde", raconte-t-elle.
Son programme est déjà presque établi. Elle compte commencer à jouer dès minuit avec ses amis, puis consacrer une bonne partie de ses journées à explorer le jeu, tout en conservant du temps pour son chien et quelques activités familiales.
Marie est loin d'être la seule accro à avoir posé sa RTT. Selon les données de la plateforme internationale de gestion RH Remote, les congés posés en France pour le jeudi 19 novembre sont 35% plus nombreux qu'à la même date en 2025. La France se classe ainsi au septième rang des pays où cette progression est la plus importante. Le phénomène est encore plus spectaculaire en Italie, où le nombre de congés a presque doublé (+91%). L'Inde (+60%), l'Irlande (+57%) et l'Espagne (+44%) figurent également parmi les pays les plus concernés.
À l'échelle mondiale, Remote constate une augmentation de 32% des congés pour ce jeudi par rapport au même jour de la semaine en 2025. Hors période estivale, il s'agit de la plus forte progression enregistrée en 2026 pour un jour ouvré dans les données de l'entreprise.
Et les salariés ne comptent pas nécessairement se contenter d'une seule journée. Parmi ceux qui ont posé leur jeudi 19 novembre, 29,3% ont également pris leur vendredi 20 novembre, contre 16,5% l'année précédente. Les jeunes salariés sont particulièrement concernés. Chez les membres de la génération Z, les congés ont presque doublé (+97%). Chez les jeunes hommes de cette génération, la hausse atteint même 120%. Ces chiffres doivent néanmoins être interprétés avec prudence : Remote mesure les congés effectivement posés, sans pouvoir déterminer systématiquement leurs motivations. Toutes ces absences ne sont donc pas nécessairement liées à GTA 6.
Une autre étude réalisée en France par Lucca confirme cette tendance. En comparant les congés prévus les 19 et 20 novembre à ceux de la semaine suivante, puis en étudiant l'évolution de ce rapport par rapport aux années précédentes, l'entreprise observe une progression de 8,4% pour l'ensemble des salariés. Son logiciel présent dans 7.000 entreprises et qui est utilisé par 750.000 salariés a mesuré 25.123 demandes d’absence posées pour le 19 et/ou le 20 novembre.
Chez les moins de 35 ans, cette hausse atteint 16%, soit près de 9.500 demandes. Un résultat qui confirme que la sortie du jeu coïncide avec un surcroît inhabituel de congés, particulièrement marqué chez les jeunes act

articles.t: GTA 6 animals guide: What you can spot, pet, hunt, and fish for in Leonida
articles.chapeau: You can pet cats, log bird sightings, and go fishing across Rockstar's fictional version of Florida. Oh, and get eaten by an alligator.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI launches Nov. 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, and as the game unlocks around the world , players are already sharing clips of their first encounters with the local wildlife.
Beyond the streets of Vice City, Leonida — Rockstar's fictional take on Florida — is home to more than 170 animal species according to Game Informer , from alligators ( that can eat you! ) and manatees to jellyfish and dogs of several breeds. That's a massive jump from the roughly 28 species in GTA 5 . Some are there to spot and log in your wildlife journal, while others invite you to stop and interact — and some can even become your pets.
Here's what we know about the animals in GTA 6 so far, and what you can do when you find them.
The wildlife in Leonida gets pretty specific to Florida. There are the animals you'd probably expect, like flamingos, manatees, and alligators, plus a few that might surprise you, like green iguanas, cane toads, and rhesus macaques. Yes, Florida really does have monkeys. And if you head up to Mount Kalaga, it’s worth stopping to see what’s going on around you. One of Rockstar's screenshots shows a cougar stalking a group of deer, so mind your surroundings.
So far, people have spotted everything from armadillos, beavers, and raccoons to black bears, bobcats, and boars. There are also foxes, otters, skunks, squirrels, frogs, turtles, and snakes, plus cows, horses, cats, and dogs. And if you're the kind of person who stops to pet every dog you pass, there are already reports of Australian shepherds, Chihuahuas, Dobermans, German shepherds, Labradors, and Rottweilers.
There's plenty to look for along the water, too. Think pelicans, herons, and spoonbills, along with ducks, gulls, cormorants, cranes, and those flamingos. Eagles, pigeons, storks, and woodpeckers have also turned up. In the water itself, sightings range from crayfish, eels, and jellyfish to dolphins, sea turtles, manta rays, hammerhead sharks, and whales. If you go scuba diving off the Leonida Keys, some of the marine life even glows .
A few sightings are still up for debate. GTABase lists possums and rats, for example, while IGN left both off its list.
If you pass by an adorable cat or dog, you can pet both. Petting a cat actually gives Jason a small focus boost, and if a dog's owner gives you permission, you can give it a treat. Some gas stations sell pet treats, according to The Guardian , and you also have the option to praise or scold either animal.
You can also run into a cat while stealing a car. In one clip, Jason drives off, hears loud meowing, and suddenly has a cat lunging at him. A timed button prompt lets him fend it off, and from there, you can pull over and let the cat out or keep driving. As one user put it, "Cats Are Now Gangsters."
Apparently, dogs in Leonida like jet skis, too. One player in a post on X swam out to see how far they could get from shore and found a dog sitting on a jet ski that users can ride with. How it got out there is anybody's guess.
Back on dry land, Jason has a pet of his own. Dolores, a snake, lives at his house in the Leonida Keys, and feeding her a mouse gives him a small focus boost. So far, she's the only pet Jason can keep in the story, according to Cultured Vultures .
You can also keep track of the animals you see. Open the weapon wheel, select your binoculars, and zoom in on an animal. Then hold R1 on PlayStation or RB on Xbox to add it to your wildlife logbook. There are 62 types of birds to spot, as we covered in our GTA 6 birdwatching guide , and different breeds of cats and dogs get their own entries. Studying any 100 of the 255 entries counts toward 100 percent completion, according to PowerPyx .
There's also a zoo to visit, and you can go fishing or hunting. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told YouTuber TGG that fishing is catch-and-release, so every fish goes back in the water, even during a challenge, as GameSpot reported .
Hunting is a way to earn money. Jason's old Army friend Bret Vogel teaches him how to track deer before sending him after other animals. Some hunting challenges spell out exactly what to look for. According to the outlet, some send players after a boar, a rattlesnake, and a panther.

articles.t: GTA 6 Banks: Locations, Values, and Security Levels
GTA 6 n’était pas encore entre les mains de tous qu’il réalisait déjà un exploit
articles.chapeau: Le lancement de « Grand Theft Auto 6 » a provoqué une ruée sur les diffusions en direct, avec des millions de spectateurs réunis sur Twitch, YouTube et Kick.
articles.txt:
Certains ont attendu 13 ans pour pouvoir jouer à GTA 6 . D’autres n’ont pas voulu patienter quelques heures de plus pour découvrir à quoi il ressemblait. Avant même sa sortie en France ce jeudi 19 novembre à minuit, le nouveau jeu de Rockstar Games avait déjà cumulé l’équivalent de plus de 1 500 années de visionnage sur Twitch , selon les chiffres communiqués par la plateforme au média spécialisé IGN .
Derrière ce chiffre impressionnant se cachent des dizaines de millions d’heures de vidéos regardées par les internautes. Il ne s’agit évidemment pas de 1 500 années écoulées, mais du temps de visionnage additionné de tous les spectateurs venus assister aux premières parties de Grand Theft Auto VI .
À l’origine de cette ruée ? Le décalage horaire. En Nouvelle-Zélande, les joueurs ont pu accéder au nouveau jeu dès mercredi, alors qu’il fallait encore patienter en France et dans une grande partie du monde. Les premiers à se lancer dans l’aventure ont aussitôt diffusé leurs parties en direct, offrant aux internautes un aperçu de Vice City, la ville fictive inspirée de Miami où se déroule le jeu.
Et le succès ne s’est pas fait attendre. D’après les données fournies par Twitch, GTA 6 a dépassé le précédent record de 1,7 million de spectateurs simultanés établi par Valorant en 2020, lors du lancement de sa bêta fermée. La plateforme a même comptabilisé plus de 3,3 millions de spectateurs connectés au même moment dans la catégorie GTA 6 au cours de la journée de mercredi.
Mais l’engouement a largement dépassé les frontières de Twitch . Selon StreamCharts , les diffusions du jeu ont attiré jusqu’à 6,38 millions de spectateurs simultanés sur Twitch, YouTube et Kick réunis, mercredi 18 novembre à 12 h 30 UTC (13 h 30 heure de Paris).
L’audience est d’autant plus remarquable que les internautes n’avaient rien à gagner en regardant les autres jouer, sinon pour le plaisir de découvrir le jeu en avant-première. Contrairement à la bêta de Valorant en 2020, dont certaines diffusions permettaient d’obtenir un accès au jeu, celles de GTA 6 ne donnaient droit à aucune récompense du type. Les spectateurs étaient donc simplement venus découvrir ce nouvel opus, attendu depuis la sortie de GTA 5 en 2013.
Pendant que des millions d’internautes suivaient les premières parties en ligne, d’autres ont tout fait pour y avoir accès le plus vite possible. Certains ont ainsi modifié les paramètres de localisation de leur console pour accéder au jeu avant son lancement dans leur pays. En France, GTA 6 est disponible depuis minuit sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series.
L’attente était telle que certains joueurs avaient posé des jours de congé pour l’occasion. Selon la plateforme RH Remote , le nombre de congés demandés pour le 19 novembre a augmenté de 32 % à l’échelle mondiale.

articles.t: « J'aurai la grippe quelques jours » : comment les vestiaires vont gérer la frénésie autour de la sortie de GTA VI
'GTA 6' on Xbox Series S: How well it actually runs
articles.chapeau: Here's the verdict.
articles.txt:
Reading through Reddit, there is no shortage of concerns about how well Xbox Series S will or won’t run the game. As the release neared, fans seemed confident that Rockstar Games would ensure the game was playable, but opinions varied widely on what graphical sacrifices would be required for it to run, including reduced crowd density and scaled-back visuals.
How much time did I spend sweating the idea of crowd density? Too much. Did I ever think about it or care about it until Redditors said it’ll likely be less on the Series S? Not at all.
And yet, while it filled me with regret for not buying a PS5 last Black Friday before the price hikes arrived, it did not stop me from buying GTA 6 on Xbox Series S, debating whether or not to resist the pull off the New Zealand timezone trick to play it early, and preparing to explore Leonida.
And now, having played GTA 6 for a few hours, I can tell you everything you need to know about how it runs and how it feels.
I won’t keep you waiting: GTA 6 runs smooth as butter on Xbox Series S. There were no stutters, no lag or other slowdowns that pulled me out of the gameplay.
During a prologue that introduced me to protagonists Jason and Lucia, I quickly experienced a variety of locations in daytime and nighttime, as well as rainy weather. After that, I was able to play around Leonida and check out all the basic things that might catch your attention as you play: how the weather looks, flying down the road in a car through busy streets, random tasks around Jason's home.
In addition to moving quickly through various areas, I also took a moment to slow down. I watched a sunset by the water, went for a swim surrounded by fish, and observed how the environment affected Jason. Nothing slowed down, glitched out, or made me think anything other than I was playing a AAA game.
What I can’t tell you right now is how much better GTA 6 is or isn’t on PS5 or any of the higher-end consoles. We’re in the process of comparing the Xbox Series S version to the PS5 Pro version as we speak.
Rockstar has explicitly said the game will run best on PS5 consoles, with faster load times and technology that may improve resolution. The PS5 Pro version will also include ray tracing, making the lighting even more eye-catching. But both games will still be locked at 30 frames per second, according to Rockstar. The game developer did not say if any other sacrifices had to be made to get it to run on the Xbox Series S.
Regardless, what I can tell you is there is a good game waiting for you to play on Xbox Series S. If you don’t have the funds to upgrade your console, do not let comparison be the thief of joy.
GTA 6 is a generational moment in gaming and a cultural moment much larger than any game launch I’ve ever seen. The game is fun, the music is a vibe, and the world is immersive without feeling like a chore. I can't imagine waiting to play this if they have the means to do so right now.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' on PC: What we know about the PC release
articles.chapeau: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is the most-anticipated video game of all time.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI will be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles at launch (it will also be available on Xbox Cloud Gaming , with limits).
GTA 6 has no confirmed PC release date. Given Rockstar's history with PC ports, we originally thought gamers were in for a long wait.
An October 2026 report from gaming business media site Gamesbeat reveals a potential PC launch in early 2027, which is sooner than we expected.
The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on Nov. 19, 2026, but PC players will have to wait a while longer. Rockstar has confirmed that the game will not be available for PC gamers at launch, and no PC version has been officially announced yet.
Despite that, we recently got some good news: GamesBeat reports that GTA 6 will get a PC release sometime in Q1 of 2027. GamesBeat has a good track record with unannounced news like this. According to their reporting, the GTA 6 PC release window was confirmed by industry sources familiar with Rockstar's plans. They spoke with the outlet under the condition of anonymity.
Rockstar and Take-Two haven't given an official reason for skipping PC at launch, but a few factors are typically cited when publishers stagger releases this way.
Console hardware is standardized, which tends to make optimization more straightforward than building for the huge range of PC configurations. Some industry data has also indicated that consoles generate higher per-unit revenue, giving publishers an incentive to front-load console sales.
A more cynical take is that Take-Two could just be double-dipping, hoping fans who can't wait for the PC launch will buy the console first, then buy the PC version later. A PC Gamer poll found that 39 percent of respondents said they're fine waiting for a port rather than needing it on day one, suggesting a meaningful share of the PC audience isn't treating the delay as a dealbreaker.
However, there could be another, less financially motivated reason for all of this.
Speaking to YouTuber KiwiTalkz , former Rockstar producer John Ricchio explained that building for consoles first and scaling up to PC is technically easier than the reverse, since consoles have fixed, predictable hardware. According to IGN , Ricchio said it's simpler to start with tighter constraints and add polish later than to build a PC-first game and then try to trim it down to fit console limitations.
Without an official release date, gamers have had to speculate on the most likely launch window for a GTA 6 PC version.
If you look at several past Rockstar games, you can see that there's typically a significant amount of time between the console launch and the PC port.
Grand Theft Auto 4 was released in April 2008 and didn't reach PC's until December. Grand Theft Auto V was released in Sept. 2013, and its PC counterpart was released 19 months later in April 2015. Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived on PC roughly a year after its console release.
The one exception was Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition , which launched simultaneously across platforms in 2021. Based on that track record, a GTA 6 PC port, if it follows the usual pattern, could be a year or more away.
A report from The Verge claimed that Xbox would have exclusive rights to stream GTA 6 via its cloud gaming service at launch, a claim that was recently confirmed. The report noted that PC gamers would be able to play GTA 6 on day one , despite Rockstar's lack of news about a potential release window for a PC port. Unfortunately, Xbox Gaming's Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball, shot down this report. Ball wrote on his personal X account that The Verge's coverage led to some "misreporting."
Again, the game will be available to play on Xbox consoles via Xbox Cloud Gaming, but that service faces strict monthly limits, which will make it difficult to play through the game in a timely fashion.
Fortunately, a GamesBeat report suggests gamers may not have to wait a full year for a PC release, though it remains unconfirmed.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' NPCs explained: How characters react to players
articles.chapeau: Early gameplay clips show how differently people can react, whether you taunt them on the sidewalk or cut them off in traffic.
articles.txt:
On a walk through Vice City, you might pass tourists taking vacation photos, someone playing Frisbee with their dog, or a bouncer working the door at a club. A little farther down the street, you could see a carjacking, a police chase, or someone dancing on the roof of a car. And all of that can happen while you're just on your way to buy a T-shirt or pair of shoes.
Ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI ’ s Nov. 19 release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S , early reviews, gameplay clips, and livestreamers are giving us a better sense of who we'll meet in Vice City and across Leonida, Rockstar's fictional version of Florida. The game is packed full of NPCs, short for non-player characters , and stopping to talk to one can lead to anything from a quick hello to a whole new side quest.
The detail that went into many of these characters is clearly impressive, or as one X user said, " nothing short of magic ," which makes sense considering Rockstar put together an entire team in Los Angeles to give the people you pass on the street more personality. The studio created roughly 600,000 animations for its NPCs, Edge reported last month .
Players are already posting their strangest NPC encounters, and we're learning a lot about how they work. Now of course, a short video can be hard to authenticate, especially when AI can mimic gameplay footage, so note that we haven't independently verified every clip making the rounds. Nevertheless, here's what early reviews and gameplay clips suggest can happen when you run into some of these characters.
In GTA 6 , you can greet or taunt NPCs as you pass, and they will all react in different ways depending in part on their individual temperament, what they've seen, and how you've treated them, according to Edge . Some are especially hostile and can pick a fight, slap you, and even follow you onto the road. In a gameplay clip posted by the GTA 6 Updates account, another driver chases Jason after he cuts her off. One streamer Paisley found NPCs in will "hunt you down and try to murder you if you hit their car."
"Even the grandmas in Vice City are dangerous," according to one X user , who shared a clip of an elderly woman in a scooter robbing another NPC at gunpoint. When the player intervened, she turned her weapon on them. "GTA 6 NPCs are absolutely unhinged," the user added.
NPCs are often causing chaos in the background. In one clip , a man was filling up his gas tank when he lit himself on fire. Another saunters the beach with a pet alligator on a leash. One NPC "asked Jason for a cigarette, spat it into the air, caught it in his mouth, and then high-fived himself when Jason left him hanging"
There is a wide mix of people in the game, and their jobs vary by district. Rockstar built nearly 500 repeatable scenes across 12,500 locations. Even overheard dialogue can be worth sharing — in a clip from streamer N3ON's playthrough, he is speechless after hearing an NPC say " clip that. " Not even Leonida is safe from the latest streamer lingo. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile
An NPC's job shapes the options you get when approaching them. For example, Rockstar's extended gameplay footage shows Jason choosing how to get a bouncer's attention . Shopkeepers can also jump into action when trouble walks through the door. In The Verge 's review, gang members followed the reviewer into a clothing store. The shopkeeper called the police, forcing the reviewer to empty the register before making a getaway. And that's just one example — we've seen other clips of NPCs calling the cops on Jason throughout the game.
You can also come across police who are busy with someone else. During one demo, Jason passed two officers who were already making an arrest. Streamer BlueThunderReal described getting close enough to a police perimeter that officers told them to " clear out ."
Some of the people working across Leonida are also part of Jason and Lucia's story. In the Keys, Jason works for smuggler Brian Heder and knows one of his associates, Cal Hampton. On the music side, nightclub owner Boobie Ike runs a record label with Dre'Quan Priest, and the rap duo Real Dimez are signed to it. Then there's Raul Bautista, a bank robber who’s always looking for people to bring in on a job.
Rockstar worked out some of those connections far beyond the named cast. Senior design director Steve Messinger said that the team mapped how drugs move through gang compounds and reach buyers

articles.t: Travis Scott x Nike GTA 6 sneakers get release dates
articles.chapeau: Travis Scott, Nike and Rockstar bring GTA 6 to Air Force 1 sneakers and apparel, with drops on November 21 and 23.
articles.txt:
The world of Grand Theft Auto has always had its own visual language: wanted stars, fictional city maps and a sense of mischief that extends well beyond the screen. Now those details are turning up on one of sneaker culture's most familiar silhouettes, just as Rockstar Games' long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI reaches its launch window.
Travis Scott's Cactus Jack label, Nike and Rockstar Games are bringing GTA VI branding to the Air Force 1 Low and a coordinated apparel collection. The project gives fans another way to participate in the game's release moment, this time through shoes and clothing rather than gameplay.
The two widely reported Air Force 1 Low colorways are predominantly black and white, each with pink accents and details drawn from Grand Theft Auto. The standard Air branding on the midsole gives way to GTA lettering, while six stars refer to the game's maximum Wanted Level. Rockstar logos appear on the lace hardware, and Travis Scott's reversed Swoosh remains a prominent signature.
The black shoe uses textured materials and contrasting insoles. The white edition has a patent-leather finish and mismatched insoles, including a map graphic. Both include a removable money-band detail across the toe. Hypebeast lists the black pair as JJ7604-001 and the white pair as JJ7602-100.
The designs do more than add a game logo to an existing sneaker. The stars, map, mismatched details and branded hardware translate recognizable elements of the fictional world into physical objects that collectors can inspect and wear.
Hypebeast and WWD report that Nike SNKRS will release the black and white sneakers on November 21, 2026, followed by another release through the Cactus Jack website on November 23. The reported retail price is US$130 per pair. The later drop is also expected to include limited or exclusive variations, although availability may differ by market and product.
Sneaker News additionally reports a November 20 release through Selfridges London, before the broader SNKRS launch. Buyers should check the relevant retailer for final local timing and stock.
The project extends beyond footwear. The accompanying collection includes T-shirts and hoodies using Wanted Level stars, VI graphics, Rockstar marks and Cactus Jack references. Some garments echo the money-band details found on the shoes.
That consistency matters for a collaboration built around a game universe. A sneaker might be the centerpiece of the drop, but apparel makes the visual language available across different products and price points. It also gives the partnership a more complete streetwear identity rather than a single collectible item.
The reported November 23 Cactus Jack release adds a second moment for fans to follow after the initial Nike launch. No verified sales figures or campaign-reach numbers have been disclosed in the sources reviewed.
This partnership sits at the intersection of three audiences: GTA players, Travis Scott followers and sneaker collectors. Each brings a different reason to pay attention, from the game's launch to the musician's established design signatures and Nike's Air Force 1 heritage.
For brands exploring entertainment collaborations, the most useful detail is how much of the design is recognizable without relying on a large printed title. The six wanted stars and the reversed Swoosh function as shorthand for their respective worlds. Together they make the collaboration legible to people who already know those symbols.
The staggered release also creates more than one retail moment around the same collection. That is a distribution choice, not proof of success. Whether the collaboration translates attention into sell-through remains to be seen.
The larger cultural signal is that a major game launch can become a platform for physical fashion products. Here, the collaboration does not simply advertise GTA VI. It offers fans an object they can keep wearing after launch week.

articles.t: GTA 6 hype takes over North Texas as fans celebrate long-awaited release
articles.chapeau: The game generated $1.6 billion in presales before a single copy was released.
articles.txt:
After 13 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto VI is finally set to arrive! The highly anticipated video game launches at midnight, with expectations that it could become the biggest video game release in history. North Texas gamers are gearing up for the launch, and one fan in Dallas’ Bishop Arts District has taken his love of GTA to another level. NBC 5’s Meredith Yeomans reports from Bishop Arts on the excitement surrounding the release.
Fans gathered at Spinster Records for a listening party celebrating the highly anticipated game, which generated $1.6 billion in presales before its release.
The soundtrack to Grand Theft Auto 6 was already filling Spinster Records in Dallas as fans gathered for a listening party ahead of the game's midnight launch.
The event featured all 34 tracks from the game, record presales, free merchandise and a chance to celebrate a release 13 years in the making.
For one fan, the occasion called for a permanent tribute. He got brass knuckles — a staple of the Grand Theft Auto franchise — tattooed on his arm.
"Mostly because I played the game as a kid and it was a nostalgic feeling to like, play with my older cousins and stuff and I just feel like I needed to get it," said GTA fan Alexis Hurtado.
Some fans found ways to get their hands on the game before the official launch. Nick Trachier said he was able to play early while in New Zealand.
"I 'live in New Zealand' right now and I was able to play the game this morning for like an hour before I had to go to work. And... it's amazing. I mean it's like perfect," said Trachier.
The excitement is also reflected in the numbers. Grand Theft Auto 6 generated $1.6 billion in presales before a single copy was released.
Dr. Jack Murray, an assistant professor of game design at the University of Texas at Dallas, said the anticipation puts the game's launch in a category of its own.
"This is bigger than you know, the upcoming Marvel movie. This is bigger than any Harry Potter book launch," said Murray.
But Murray said he's also watching how players respond to the game and what their engagement looks like once they get their hands on it.
"Like what is people’s reactions going to be, how are people going to play with this, how are people going to receive it. what is the engagement going to be like," said Murray.
With millions of players expected to log on, some PlayStation users reported outages Wednesday. Sony's status page showed its services were up and running.
Murray said players had been able to preload the game throughout the week to help avoid a midnight rush. Players can download most of the game ahead of time, with the final portion unlocking at midnight.
"And then at midnight you're going to download the last little bit of the game and it will unlock on the home consoles," said Murray.
Back at Spinster Records, the soundtrack was already setting the mood for launch night. At midnight, fans would finally get to press play on Grand Theft Auto 6.
The price for GTA 6 ranges from $80 to $100, depending on the version. The game is available on PlayStation and Xbox Series X|S.
This story was originally reported for broadcast by NBC DFW. AI tools helped convert the story into a digital article, and an NBC DFW journalist edited it again before publication.

articles.t: Is PlayStation down? How to check system status for GTA 6 launch.

articles.txt:
Many gamers have already taken advantage of a sneaky little trick that allowed them to play the long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI one day early on New Zealand time.

The question is: Will PlayStation and Xbox be able to handle all the millions of gamers trying to download and access the game all at once?
With so many different companies and services suffering from outages recently, gamers may be understandably nervous. And we have you covered. Here's how you can easily tell if PlayStation or Xbox is down — or if it's just you and your internet connection.
Catch up on the latest 'Grand Theft Auto VI' news and updates from Mashable.

articles.t: La superproduction "GTA VI" enfin entre les mains de la plupart des joueurs de la planète
Les premiers joueurs sont conquis par « GTA 6 », le nouvel opus de la saga
articles.chapeau: Entre les rues de Vice City et les bayous, « GTA 6 » impressionne par le détail de ses décors. Disponible ce jeudi à minuit sur PS5 et Xbox, le jeu de Rockstar séduit joueurs et critiques
articles.txt:
A peine entré dans Vice City, le Néo-Zélandais Luke Starik a déjà eu affaire à la police. « Déjà arrêté. Je n’ai pas survécu longtemps ! », raconte-t-il. Comme les joueurs australiens et une partie du public asiatique, il a pu découvrir Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) avant l’Europe et les Etats-Unis. Le jeu de Rockstar Games sort jeudi à minuit, heure locale, sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series . Pour y accéder plus tôt, certains fans européens et américains ont changé la localisation de leur console. PlayStation a brièvement signalé des problèmes de connexion avant un retour à la normale.
Treize ans après GTA 5 , ce nouvel épisode de Grand Theft Auto suit un couple de gangsters à la Bonnie and Clyde dans une ville inspirée de Miami. Sur Reddit , un joueur qui signe No_Strike9652 livre sa première impression. « C’est très probablement l’un des plus beaux jeux que j’aie vus de ma vie », écrit-il. Un journaliste de l’AFP qui a essayé le jeu mercredi relève le réalisme des personnages, jusque dans leur façon de se mouvoir. L’attention portée aux décors se retrouve aussi bien dans les rues animées de Vice City que dans un bayou peuplé de crocodiles.
Mercredi, GTA 6 obtenait une moyenne de 99 sur 100 sur Metacritic, qui recensait une centaine de critiques de la presse spécialisée. Forbes salue « l’univers de jeu vidéo le plus impressionnant » jamais créé. Chez IGN Japan, la « représentation minutieuse de la vie quotidienne » convainc davantage que les « missions principales de conception plutôt classiques ». Le média japonais regrette aussi de trop « longs trajets en voiture ». En dehors des missions, le joueur dispose de la même liberté que dans l’épisode précédent pour prendre le volant, piloter un avion ou sauter en parachute.
Le développement a pris plus de huit ans à Rockstar Games , qui compte une douzaine de studios dans le monde et emploie plus de 4.700 personnes. En 2022, des vidéos volées ont circulé sur Internet . Le studio a ensuite repoussé deux fois la sortie du jeu et connu de nouvelles fuites l’été dernier. Les analystes situent le budget de GTA 6 entre 1 et 1,5 milliard de dollars, une estimation qui en ferait le jeu le plus cher jamais développé. Le cabinet Sensor Tower évalue les précommandes à plus de 15 millions d’exemplaires. Rockstar Games n’a pas communiqué de chiffres.
A Miami, un dirigeable a survolé la ville dans le cadre de la campagne de lancement. Take-Two Interactive, la maison mère de Rockstar, a aussi misé sur l’affichage dans plusieurs capitales pour toucher un public plus large que celui du jeu vidéo. D’après le cabinet britannique Omdia, les ventes pourraient atteindre 3,2 milliards de dollars d’ici à la fin de l’année. La plateforme de ressources humaines Remote dit pour sa part observer, à l’échelle mondiale, une hausse de 32 % du nombre de congés posés pour ce jeudi.
Depuis ses débuts, Grand Theft Auto emprunte aux grandes villes américaines leurs décors et à la société américaine les travers dont la série se moque. « C’est peut-être une version caricaturale et sous stéroïdes de la société américaine », estime Jia Wei, un joueur chinois trentenaire, qui craint que certains joueurs la confondent avec la réalité. La liberté d’action offerte dans GTA alimente aussi la controverse. Les joueurs peuvent renverser des passants, vendre de la drogue ou tirer sur la police, ce qui vaut à la série des accusations de glorification de la violence. Le Qatar, la Chine et la Russie ont notamment interdit la série.

articles.t: Meilleurs paramètres GTA 6 : quels réglages modifier avant de jouer ?
articles.chapeau: Avec son immense monde ouvert et ses nombreuses mécaniques de gameplay, Grand Theft Auto VI propose également un grand nombre d’options [...]
articles.txt:
Avec son immense monde ouvert et ses nombreuses mécaniques de gameplay, Grand Theft Auto VI propose également un grand nombre d’options permettant de personnaliser son expérience. Entre les commandes, la visée, l’affichage et les différents éléments de l’interface, certains réglages peuvent considérablement améliorer votre confort de jeu. Voici les paramètres que nous vous conseillons de modifier dans GTA 6 pour profiter pleinement de votre aventure dans Leonida.
Comment accéder aux paramètres de GTA 6 ? Avant toute chose, sachez que vous pouvez modifier les options de GTA 6 à tout moment depuis le menu pause. Rendez-vous dans Paramètres, puis naviguez entre les différents onglets à l’aide des touches L1 et R1 sur PS5 (LB et RB sur Xbox Series) . Vous y retrouverez notamment les menus Configuration des commandes, Manette, Jeu, Affichage, Interface et Caméra. La plupart des paramètres peuvent être modifiés indépendamment, sans avoir à recommencer votre partie.
Le premier réglage concerne évidemment la visée qui peut avoir une énorme influence sur votre expérience des fusillades . GTA 6 propose trois configurations, allant d’un verrouillage automatique des cibles à une visée entièrement libre. Pour les joueurs peu habitués aux jeux de tir sur console, nous conseillons de commencer avec une assistance à la visée afin de faciliter les affrontements. À l’inverse, les habitués peuvent privilégier la visée libre pour conserver un contrôle total sur leurs tirs.
Il est également possible d’ajuster l’intensité de l’aide à la visée à l’aide d’un curseur. De notre côté, nous avons privilégié la visée libre, mais cela varie selon les sensibilités de chacun. N’hésitez donc pas à expérimenter plusieurs réglages avant de faire votre choix.
Toujours dans les paramètres de combat, plusieurs options peuvent faciliter les affrontements. On retrouve notamment l’Aide au tir, l’Aide aux fusillades en véhicule et la possibilité de dégainer rapidement. Nous vous recommandons de conserver ces trois options activées dans un premier temps , particulièrement si vous découvrez les nouvelles mécaniques de GTA 6.
Les courses-poursuites peuvent rapidement devenir mouvementées et toute assistance permettant de mieux gérer les affrontements depuis un véhicule est bonne à prendre. Vous pourrez ensuite désactiver certaines aides si vous souhaitez une expérience plus exigeante.
Contrairement aux précédents épisodes, GTA 6 offre davantage de possibilités pour personnaliser l’affichage de sa mini-carte. Le mode Dynamique permet notamment de masquer la mini-carte pendant certaines phases d’exploration et de la faire réapparaître lorsque la situation le nécessite. Selon nous, il s’agit du meilleur compromis pour profiter des environnements sans surcharger l’interface.
Si vous avez tendance à vous perdre facilement ou que vous préférez garder un œil sur les rues et les objectifs à proximité, nous vous conseillons plutôt de conserver la mini-carte affichée en permanence.
En complément de la mini-carte, GTA 6 permet de personnaliser les informations affichées pendant les déplacements. Vous pouvez notamment activer ou désactiver l’itinéraire GPS, les indicateurs de direction et certains repères directement visibles dans le monde ouvert. Nous vous conseillons de conserver ces options activées pendant les premières heures. Leonida étant particulièrement vaste, elles permettent de mieux anticiper les changements de direction et de rejoindre plus facilement vos destinations.
Par la suite, libre à vous de réduire certaines indications si vous souhaitez explorer les environs avec une interface plus discrète.
Même si vous comprenez parfaitement l’anglais, nous vous recommandons vivement d’activer les sous-titres en permanence dans GTA 6 . Les dialogues ne se limitent pas aux missions principales. Il est possible d’entendre de nombreuses conversations au cours de l’exploration, notamment entre les habitants de Leonida ou lors des activités quotidiennes de Jason et Lucia.
Pour éviter de manquer certains échanges, choisissez donc l’option « Avec » dans les paramètres des sous-titres , plutôt qu’un affichage limité à certaines situations. Profitez-en également pour ajuster leur taille. L’option Moyenne représente un bon choix si vous jouez sur votre canapé devant une télévision entre 40 et 60 pouces. Vous pouvez aussi modifier leur arrière-plan afin de faciliter la lecture dans les environnements particulièrement lumineux.
Ce réglage peut se révéler particulièrement import

articles.t: Comment changer de personnage dans GTA 6 (Jason, Lucia) ?
articles.chapeau: À l’image de GTA 5, Grand Theft Auto VI permet de contrôler plusieurs protagonistes au cours de l’aventure. Cette fois, Rockstar Games [...]
articles.txt:
À l’image de GTA 5 , Grand Theft Auto VI permet de contrôler plusieurs protagonistes au cours de l’aventure. Cette fois, Rockstar Games nous propose d’incarner Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos. Il est ainsi possible de passer de l’un à l’autre pour profiter des différentes activités proposées dans l’État de Leonida. Voici comment changer de personnage dans GTA 6 et ce qu’il faut savoir sur cette mécanique.
Comment passer de Jason à Lucia dans GTA 6 ? Dans GTA 6, il est possible de passer librement de Jason à Lucia, et inversement, pendant les phases d’exploration. Cette fonctionnalité permet de prendre le contrôle de l’autre protagoniste, quelle que soit sa position sur la carte. Le changement est même instantané lorsque les deux personnages se trouvent à proximité l’un de l’autre. Cependant, cette fonctionnalité n’est pas immédiatement disponible durant le prologue. Pour la débloquer, il faut progresser dans le scénario jusqu’à la mission « Course matinale », au cours du chapitre 2 .
Pour changer de personnage, appuyez par défaut sur R1 (PS5) ou RB (Xbox Series), puis utilisez les flèches gauche ou droite de la croix directionnelle . Le changement de personnage présente plusieurs avantages, notamment lorsque vous souhaitez découvrir les activités propres à Jason et Lucia. Il peut également vous faire gagner un temps précieux, surtout si vous vous trouvez particulièrement éloigné de votre domicile ou au beau milieu d’une région reculée de Leonida.
Par ailleurs, certaines missions principales exploitent directement cette mécanique. Il est ainsi possible de passer d’un personnage à l’autre pour accomplir différents objectifs, notamment pendant les fusillades ou les courses-poursuites.
En dehors des missions principales, le changement de personnage offre une grande liberté. Vous pouvez ainsi explorer Leonida avec Jason, puis prendre le contrôle de Lucia pour poursuivre vos activités de son côté. Certaines situations vous empêchent toutefois de changer de personnage. C’est notamment le cas lorsque vous êtes poursuivi par la police et que votre partenaire ne se trouve pas à proximité.
Il faut également savoir que Jason et Lucia peuvent passer du temps ensemble ou poursuivre leurs activités séparément . Si vous souhaitez retrouver votre partenaire, il est possible de l’appeler depuis votre téléphone pour lui proposer de vous rejoindre. Vous pouvez également le faire directement en maintenant R1 et en appuyant sur Triangle sur PS5 (Et RB+Y sur Xbox).
Enfin, changer de personnage peut être une excellente solution pour éviter de longs déplacements. Si vous vous trouvez au milieu de l’océan ou à l’autre bout de Leonida, vous pouvez simplement reprendre le contrôle de votre partenaire pour commencer une nouvelle activité ailleurs sur la carte, ou encore retourner rapidement chez vous pour dormir.
Pour davantage d’astuces et de solutions sur GTA 6 , n’hésitez pas à consulter notre guide complet du jeu .

articles.t: 13 ans plus tard, la sortie de GTA 6 ravit les fans - Outre-mer La 1ère
articles.chapeau: C
articles.txt:
C'est le produit de divertissement le plus attendu de la décennie : le jeu vidéo Grand Theft Auto 6, dit aussi GTA 6, sort ce mercredi, 13 ans après le dernier épisode. Les fans se sont préparés à une longue session de jeu.
GTA 6 (image d'illustration) · ©GRICHKA BEYSSON-LEANDRI / Hans Lucas Il aura fallu attendre 13 ans : le précédent épisode, GTA 5, était sorti en 2013...
Après plusieurs reports, Grand Theft Auto 6, dit aussi GTA 6, sort enfin ce mercredi à 13 h, heure locale. " J'ai acheté la Play 5, j'ai pré-commandé le jeu. Demain, je suis en examen, mais vendredi, on n'a pas cours : je joue à GTA 6, " se réjouit Toareva, étudiant à l'université de Polynésie.
" J'ai déjà pré-commandé le jeu, mais ma Play est chez moi , regrette Nainoa. Du coup, je vais dire à mon frère de lancer le téléchargement et je vais y jouer ce week-end, quand je vais rentrer. " Grand Theft Auto est une série de jeux vidéo d'action, où l'on incarne des criminels dans une grande ville que l'on peut explorer librement. Depuis 1997, la série est devenue l'une des plus grosses franchises du divertissement, et l'un des rares succès assurés dans un secteur du jeu vidéo très concurrentiel.
Ce nouvel épisode raconte la cavale d'un couple de criminels, à la manière de Bonnie et Clyde : Lucia Caminos et Jason Duval. Après un coup qui tourne mal, les deux amants se retrouvent pris dans une vaste conspiration. Pour la première fois, la série place une femme au cœur de l'histoire comme personnage principal. Le tout se déroule à Vice City, une version fictive de Miami. Le jeu bat déjà des records. Avec environ 16 millions de précommandes, soit près d'1,5 milliard de dollars selon le cabinet Sensor Tower, c'est le jeu le plus précommandé de l'histoire. Avec une note de 99 sur 100 sur le site Metacritic, qui fait la moyenne des notes de la presse, c'est aussi l'un des jeux les mieux notés de tous les temps. On s'attend à ce que ce soit le plus gros lancement de l'histoire du divertissement, cinéma et musique compris.

articles.t: GTA 6 : police pas nulle, Pokédex et couchers de soleil... tout ce qu’on a vu en 3 heures de jeu
GTA 6's Physical Map Reportedly Leaks Ahead of Launch
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's map has reportedly leaked from the £350 collector's edition on display in a UK store — ahead of launch. Here is what happened.
articles.txt:
Gaming News Current Deals New Game Releases Free Games Hardware News TOP Sponsored GTA 6's Physical Map Reportedly Leaks Ahead of Lau ... Dark mode GTA 6's Physical Map Reportedly Leaks Ahead of Launch GAMING NEWS Fyra Frost - about 1 hour ago Ahead of launch, GTA 6 's physical map has reportedly leaked online — reportedly, because Rockstar hasn't confirmed a thing. The image was allegedly snapped during Selfridges' GTA 6 takeover in London and is believed to be the souvenir poster from the £350 Collector's Edition. Here is what happened, as of November 13, 2026.
The photo surfaced on November 13, shared by prominent Rockstar community insider Videotech, who suggested the source was a "naughty Selfridges employee" during the department store's GTA 6 takeover. It is the first look at the physical map bundled with the top-end edition — and it arrived in the final week before release.
The leak is reportedly the Collector's Edition's "double-sided souvenir poster with map of Leonida" — one of the perks of an edition that costs £350 and, famously, does not include a copy of the game itself. That quirk is confirmed: the premium box is for collectors, not for players, which makes a store-display leak of its contents almost inevitable.
If genuine, the map is stylized rather than granular — a tourism-poster look reading "The Goodtime State," a riff on Florida's Sunshine State nickname, with Leonida's landmarks dotted among cartoon figures. It appears to confirm the rough layout of the state and its key locations, though a wonky crop means fans hunting for confirmation of an in-game Key West are still none the wiser. Rockstar has previously said the map is twice the size of GTA 5's. We'll leave the landmark specifics out for readers who want to go in unspoiled.
Rockstar has not commented on the leak, and it likely won't — this is a poster, not gameplay. Previous map leaks this year were more serious: a group calling itself CyberLeek shared unofficial gameplay and map details before cashing out a crypto scheme. This one is closer to a marketing slip than a security event.
A stylized poster can't spoil the moment that actually matters: driving through Leonida at midnight on November 19. articles.t: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.chapeau: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.
articles.txt:
Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion Ryan Gladwin Wed, November 18, 2026 at 6:32 PM GMT+1 3 min read One lucky meme coin trader made bank as Grand Theft Auto 6 launched worldwide, turning $300 into over $200,000 after early footage of the game sent degens flocking from one unofficial token to another.
The trader bought $307 worth of the DCTY token shortly after it launched in October and has sold their bag for $202,278, according to DEX Screener, a profit of almost 66,000%.
Early indications had pointed to GTA 6 featuring an in-game meme coin—with, it's worth stressing, no actual blockchain element—called "DacityCoin," which appeared in the official launch trailer on a plane with a wing walker setting off a smoke bomb on top of it.
It was later linked to leaked gameplay of an mission which appeared to show game protagonist Lucia parachuting as a stunt to attract investment to DacityCoin .
Amid this hype, per DEX Screener, a real-world and unofficial DacityCoin launched using the Solana launchpad Pump.fun . It first peaked at a $4.95 million market capitalization, following the launch trailer's release, before tanking 93% to $343,620 as hype faded.
With GTA 6 set to launch within a matter of hours of publication, the token drew renewed attention, propelling it to a new all-time high of $10.8 million Wednesday. Unfortunately for investors, GTA 6's staggered global release means that some gamers are already playing it—and footage started to spread which suggested the Solana token's ticker was wrong.
The result was a rollercoaster of volatility, with the DacityCoin token now sitting at a market cap of around $800,000.
Gameplay footage from Brazilian streamer Combo Infinito suggests that the in-game token is called DacityCoin, with the ticker DCTY.
That propelled another Solana token with a seemingly accurate name and ticker sprang into action. DCTY's previous all-time high market cap was just $54,000 before the ticker was revealed, and it set a new high of over $12 million after footage of the game appeared to confirm that its ticker matched the in-game token. It is now trading at a market cap of around $10 million.
The game itself appears to be somewhat inconsistent in its naming of the in-game token. During the trailer, it appeared to be spelled "DacityCoin" as one word, however, the subtitles in the leak show it spelled as "Dacity coin," two words. Similarly, the company behind the in-game token is AudaCity, but leaks show three different spellings: Auda City, AudaCity, and Auda-City.
It is worth stressing: Rockstar has not explicitly confirmed that a meme coin will be featured in-game, and any real-world token has no official links to GTA 6 or its creators. Footage is still being released, and absolute confirmation of the in-game token's involvement is still being established.
Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
Those still holding the now-tanking DacityCoin are hoping things will turn around. Mike Lerro , the community takeover lead for DacityCoin, shrugged off any chance that the unofficial token's name and ticker are wrong.
"No, bro. DacityCoin and AudaCity are in the game. Yes or no?" When Decrypt suggested the ticker might be wrong, he replied, "It doesn't matter… Okay and ? The person who creates it will dump on you then it goes to zero. Who's gonna [do the community takeover]? No one."
"DACITYCOIN AND AUDACITY ARE IN THE GAME," Lerro wrote in the meme coin's Telegram. "NOTHING ELSE MATTERS."
"It's so crazy, it'll correct itself," Lerro said in an emergency Telegram group chat call. "I hope so," an investor replied.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance jumps to 280 fps on PC, with DLSS 5 transforming Lucia
articles.chapeau: Capture cards and Nvidia DLSS give a glimpse of what a GTA 6 PC port may look like. In a GameGPU test, the PS5 Pro version sees frame rates rise from 30 to 280 fps. DLSS 5 neural rendering enhances lighting and shadows, but Lucia may be unrecognizable compared with trailer footage.
articles.txt:
As the release date arrived, Rockstar cast doubt on future performance upgrades for the flagship PlayStation console. With frame rates stuck at 30 fps , the GTA 6 PS5 Pro version prioritizes visual fidelity. A PC port lurks as a way to experience smoother graphics. Using capture software and NeuralScreen, new videos show what DLSS 5 and high-end hardware can do.
GameGPU recorded multiple clips via an AVerMedia Live Gamer Ultra 2.1 external capture card connected to the PS5 Pro. PC specs include an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU and an Nvidia RTX 5090 graphics card . At maximum settings, the console’s video output was set to 4K.
In a scene where Lucia is still in prison, DLSS 4.5 frame generation produces frame rates between 262 and 286 fps. Nevertheless, players may find the effects of DLSS 5 controversial.
Nvidia’s neural rendering adds detail to the GTA 6 PS5 Pro feed throughout the jail cell. With light entering a window, reflections and shadows look more natural. Lucia’s individual strands of hair become visible, but her face has undergone the most obvious transformation.
Without DLSS 5 active on the PC, the character resembles what fans have seen in official trailers . When on, Lucia’s face is photorealistic with varied textures and a different skin tone. Many critics worry that neural rendering distorts the original vision of developers and artists.
The second video depicts Jason standing on a dock during a swampland mission. Thanks to frame generation, readings jump to as high as 278 fps, and GTA 6 performance avoids stutters . Nvidia’s AI technology again improves the lighting and shadows in the outdoor scene. Jason’s clothes display ripples, and his beard stubble is more noticeable.
Unfortunately, GameGPU’s setup is likely not a practical method to play the GTA 6 PS5 Pro release. Input lag threatens to delay controller inputs for steering cars and aiming guns . Alternatives like the SmoovPlay app rely on PS Remote Play , but they face the same issues. Rockstar has yet to comment on when a native PC port might debut.

articles.t: All PS5 users forced out of accounts as GTA 6 executes strictest measures yet
articles.chapeau: Get set for launch with this new update!
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has the same level of protection as some worldwide political leaders, with PlayStation practically being its head of security.
Both Rockstar Games and PlayStation have been banging on about how GTA VI plays best on the PS5 , and both companies are taking every measure imaginable to keep the game on consoles.
We live in an age where hackers and modders can use AI to make unofficial PC ports, which would be catastrophic for GTA VI in more ways than one.
To combat this, PlayStation has released a new PS5 firmware update that’s essential for playing GTA VI at launch.
Anyone who doesn’t download this new firmware will lose access to PSN , which is needed to verify if your copy of the game is legitimate.
This is because hacked consoles cannot be used online, so it should in theory prevent any copies of the game from being ripped and leaked online.
Many believe it’s a futile effort though. Despite action from console manufacturers, hacking is becoming easier every day thanks to AI tools.
We’ve seen it happen with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026). When GTA VI releases worldwide on November 19, there’s a good chance we’ll have an unofficial PC port later that week.
It’ll no doubt be motivated by there being no official way of playing the game on PC come launch day. The core playerbase for the Grand Theft Auto series exists on consoles, so like GTA V, Rockstar will likely wait a year or so to release a PC version itself.
Interestingly, it sounds like this might coincide with the launch of GTA VI: Online.
READ MORE: GTA 6 Online: Release date speculation, latest news and everything we know
An unofficial PC port of the game would be a PR nightmare, but it could at least tackle one of the biggest complaints regarding the game’s launch: the framerate.
GTA VI is confirmed to target 30fps at all times, meaning everyone who bought a shiny, new TV and PS5 Pro in preparation for the big day may have wasted their money.
Even the mighty PS5 Pro won’t display the game at 60fps, though depending on your TV you might be able to simulate the feeling .
Should an unofficial PC port surface, there’s a good chance modders will be able to unlock the framerate like they’ve done with other games, for example Bloodborne .
Don’t get too excited though. To play it yourself you’ll have to pirate a copy of the game which we wouldn’t recommend, and there’ll probably be a suite of technical problems that come with the unlocked framerate. If Rockstar felt 30fps was enough, it was for a good reason.
GTA VI launches worldwide on November 19, but unlocks in New Zealand later today.

articles.t: GTA 6 reviews award 99 Metacritic score, topping GTA 4 to become Rockstar's top-rated
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 Metacritic verdict is in, and reviews conclude it exceeds the loftiest expectations. On its release date, the title’s 99 Metascore beats Rockstar’s GTA 5, GTA 4, GTA 3, and Red Dead Redemption 2. It’s also tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the aggregator’s top game of all time.
articles.txt:
As leaked, the GTA 6 review embargo expired when the title unlocked in New Zealand at midnight local time. Scores quickly populated Metacritic , averaging 99 and making it Rockstar ’s highest-rated game ever. Critics praise the massive Leonida map while dismissing concerns about a lackluster story .
Currently, the aggregator shows exclusively positive scores. Players who survived the long buildup to launch must wait 36 hours following the GTA 6 release date to submit user ratings. Even so, journalists are impressed and have awarded it Universal Acclaim status.
Despite fears that Rockstar would limit access to avoid leaks , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was anxious to read GTA 6 reviews. As it turns out, more than 140 outlets received Xbox or PS5 codes in recent weeks. After boasting about the studio’s past performance, Zelnick will welcome the latest Metacritic consensus.
ⓘ screenshot, Metacritic GTA 6 Metacritic score shown Jason and Lucia ’s crime epic edges out GTA 4 , which notched an average score of 98 in 1999. GTA 5 , GTA 3 , and Red Dead Redemption 2 are closely behind at 97. The game has also tied the 1998 N64 classic Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic’s highest-rated entry of all time .
Much larger than previous open-world maps , Leonida lives up to its promise, according to reviews. Each region has a unique feel, enhanced by an overhauled dynamic weather system . More buildings are explorable, addressing a popular fan request.
The fictional take on Florida can test the limits of Xbox and PS5 consoles. Although frame rates target 30 fps , release date performance impressions are reassuring. Digital Foundry measured sporadic dips below that mark, but the visuals generally remain smooth. Most importantly, controls are responsive even when rendering at below 60 fps.
When avoiding side activities, some GTA 6 reviews clock the time to complete Jason and Lucia’s story at around 60 hours. The overwhelming amount of content can stall the narrative’s pacing at times. Nevertheless, without revealing spoilers, the writing is compelling with unexpected twists.
Minor quibbles include a Vice City that's overly congested with cars and NPCs , which can slow missions. Regardless, Take-Two and Rockstar will be happy with the record-setting 99 GTA 6 Metacritic rating.

articles.t: Sortie de GTA 6 : démarrage en prison, braquage et fuite, musique dingue… On a vu les premières images du jeu de l’année
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6, le jeu le plus attendu de l’année, voire de la décennie, est sorti à midi heure française en Nouvelle-Zélande. Donnant a
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6, le jeu le plus attendu de l’année, voire de la décennie, est sorti à midi heure française en Nouvelle-Zélande. Donnant aux joueurs les plus impatients les premières images.
Depuis des semaines, le monde du jeu vidéo n’attend que ça : ça y est, Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6 est enfin disponible, treize ans après le cinquième volet . Et les premiers chanceux à pouvoir y jouer sont les Néo-Zélandais, grâce au décalage horaire. Rockstar Games, l’éditeur du jeu, a en effet choisi de sortir son produit phare le jeudi 19 novembre à minuit heure locale de chaque pays. En France donc, les premières images et diffusions en direct sont accessibles depuis ce mercredi midi.
Une attente interminable et enfin les premières images, y compris venant de streamers français étant parvenus à mettre leur console à l’heure néo-zélandaise . Un premier chargement long, très long, laissant craindre à un bug. Puis des paramètres à configurer, reculant encore l’arrivée à Vice City, lieu où se déroule le jeu.
🚨BREAKING: GTA 6 Game intro officially released pic.twitter.com/UsX6ndby4n
D’entrée, le ton est donné : une première cinématique. Une voiture en train d’être volée et les deux protagonistes : Lucia et Jason. La police qui intervient, un premier coup de poing et des forces de l’ordre tabassées. Le tout avec une musique immersive, mais bloquée chez certains streamers pour des raisons de droits d’auteur. Bienvenue dans GTA 6. La scène suivante montre les deux protagonistes chez eux… en pleine embrouille.
Après de nombreux crédits, une nouvelle cinématique transporte le joueur dans la vie de Lucia, neuf mois avant les premières scènes. Puis un nouveau flash-back. Lucia est cette fois en prison, tenue orange typique des détenus américains sur le dos.
Officially GTA 6 GAMEPLAY ( Intro Prison Scene #GTA6 ) pic.twitter.com/4R7FMkitnI
C’est là que le jeu commence vraiment. Lucia est contrôlable dans un monde ouvert, typique des GTA aux graphiques qui semblent soignés malgré les 30 images par seconde. Fidèle aux attentes sur ce point.
L’ellipse narrative prend fin, retour dans un bar avec Lucia. Quelques secondes après, on la retrouve pistolet à la main en plein braquage d’un point de retrait d’argent. Le joueur reprend la main en pleine fuite, coursée par la police. La première séquence avec Jason survient pour sa part sur un bateau, suivie d’une première mission où le joueur est amené (très) largement à utiliser son arme à feu et à esquiver les balles.
HAHAHA il a réussi à rater le tuto de GTA 6 😭 pic.twitter.com/RelSWLyi5z
Sans grande surprise, les premiers instants de ce nouvel opus transportent le joueur directement dans ce qu’il attendait : l’intrigue, le cadre, les armes… En moins d’une heure, il aura contrôlé deux personnages, une voiture, un bateau et… un hydravion avec lequel il est possible de s’amuser à faire des loopings ou de se crasher. Bref un monde où presque tout est permis dès les débuts.
Dès 11h45 heure française, mois d’une demi-heure donc avant le début des premières diffusions en direct, plus de 650 000 spectateurs de tous les pays attendaient déjà sur la plate-forme Twitch . Et le chiffre n’a cessé de monter pour dépasser le million à midi et les 2,5 millions à 12h40.
« Il y a de fortes chances que Twitch vive son plus grand record d’audience jamais enregistré », glissait au Parisien début novembre Dan Clancy, son PDG. D’après le cabinet spécialisé Sensor Tower, le jeu a été précommandé à plus de quinze millions d’exemplaires partout dans le monde.

articles.t: The full 'GTA 6' soundtrack reportedly leaked: See every artist and track
articles.chapeau: From Justice's original score to radio stations hosted by Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey, here's a guide to the music of "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
From the sun-soaked synth-pop of Vice City to surfing a sea of radio stations, music has always been an essential part of Rockstar Games' gritty, open-world franchise. And with Grand Theft Auto VI taking players back to Vice City, the sprawling soundtrack is shaping up to be just as ambitious as the game itself.
Rockstar has already revealed a 34-track album featuring artists like Travis Scott, Cardi B, and PinkPantheress, along with an original score composed by the French electronic duo Justice. Meanwhile, the game's fictional radio stations are bringing some familiar voices to the airwaves, including Robyn, Bad Bunny, and Lana Del Rey.
And that's just what we know so far. Ahead of GTA 6 's Nov. 19 release , we're keeping track of every confirmed song, artist, radio station, and celebrity DJ coming to Leonida. Consider this your unofficial guide to the sounds of Vice City.
Rockstar has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , a 34-track collection of original music arriving Nov. 19, the same day as the game.
The album features an eclectic mix of artists and genres , from hip-hop heavyweights Travis Scott and Cardi B to country star Morgan Wallen and Puerto Rican singer Rauw Alejandro. There's even a collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and French producer Etienne de Crécy. And somehow, someway, Morgan Wallen's single is the most-streamed track from the soundtrack on Spotify, with more than 25 million streams. Yung Lean, fight back!
"Sexy Magic" — CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Étienne de Crécy
"Flower in a Hurricane" — Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
"Overtown Lights" — Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper
Fans can listen to the available singles on Rockstar's official GTA 6 music website , where the album is also available to pre-save or pre-order on vinyl and CD.
The French electronic duo Justice, consisting of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, is responsible for the original score of Grand Theft Auto VI .
Rockstar confirmed the news on Oct. 15 alongside the game's launch trailer , which features the debut of Justice's new single, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
It's a fitting collaboration for a game returning to Vice City, a fictional playground known for its vibrant nightlife and electronic music. Justice's signature blend of distorted synths, disco, and dance music feels particularly suited to Rockstar's radiant criminal underworld.
The duo previously collaborated with Tame Impala on "Neverender" from their 2024 album Hyperdrama . The song won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2025 Grammys.
Rockstar has also confirmed that an official score album is on the way, although additional details, including its release date and tracklist, have yet to be announced.
The fictional radio stations are one of Grand Theft Auto 's most beloved features, and GTA 6 is bringing some major star power to the airwaves.
On Oct. 8, Rockstar unveiled six radio stations , each with its own musical identity and celebrity hosts. Among the biggest names are Bad Bunny, Robyn, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, and members of Slayer.
Here's a breakdown of the confirmed stations and their hosts :

Deux cartes présentées comme des représentations de Leonida, l’État fictif dans lequel se déroule le jeu de Rockstar Games, circulent sur les réseaux sociaux. Elles montreraient un territoire particulièrement vaste, composé de cinq comtés, de grandes zones rurales, de marécages et de nombreuses routes. Leur origine exacte n’a cependant pas été authentifiée. Plusieurs éléments visuels semblent correspondre à des documents promotionnels officiels, mais cela ne suffit pas à confirmer l’ensemble des informations diffusées. Une chose est certaine : ces images relancent les discussions autour de l’un des jeux vidéo les plus attendus de ces dernières années.

Ces éléments donnent l’impression d’un territoire conçu pour proposer des environnements très différents, entre ville, campagne, zones humides et littoral.
